title: Self signed certificate
symptom: User wants to use xDrip as an uploader over HTTPS with a self-signed certificate to a self-hosted Nightscout instance, but cannot upload data outside home network because they lack a domain and Let's Encrypt cannot issue certificates for IP addresses.
evidence_quote: is it possible to add an Option to use xdrip as an uploader over https (Nightscout/Freestyle Libre 2/Rest API) with a self signed certificate.
